LanguageData.AA_Bobeene.description: Huge insects created specifically to feed on the gigantic flowers of an utopìan Idyllic Meadow. Although based on an obviously insectoid geneline, they have been carefully designed to produce meat that is virtually indistinguishable from beef.
LanguageData.AA_ChameleonYak.description: A long-haired domesticated bovid that has evolved a fascinating survival mechanism involving camouflage, similar to the way a chameleon changes its skin colour in response to different stimuli.
LanguageData.AA_ChemfuelMyrmidon.description: An ant-like creature created as a replacement for the ubiquitous boomalope. Chemfuel Myrmidons consume both meat and vegetables and ferment them into a powerful chemfuel mixture, which can be periodically extracted from the animal.
LanguageData.AA_CrepuscularBeetle.description: Very large arthropods reminiscent of oversized Hercules beetles, they are peaceful herbivores that originate from a mysterious Rimworld orbiting a very faint star, perpetually covered in darkness.
LanguageData.AA_DevilSheep.description: A genetically engineered sheep capable of producing extremely strong and valuable red wool.
LanguageData.AA_FrostboundBehemoth.description: A large arthropod adapted to extreme low temperatures, feeding on half inorganic vegetation. Its slow metabolism makes it a very efficient creature, which allows it to survive in such environments.
LanguageData.AA_GreyCoatedMouflon.description: A genetically modified variant of wild sheep that produces a thick grey wool that acts as a great insulator.
LanguageData.AA_IronhuskBeetle.description: Peaceful farm animals that occasionally shed metallic husks that can be used as steel, thus negating the need for heavy machinery in mining operations.
LanguageData.AA_LuciferBug.description: A small insectoid, genetically modified to produce small batches of Luciferium extract every few days. Even though they are useful as a source of the dangerous drug, the fact that Luciferium is a mechanite-based drug makes luciferbugs extremely unstable, and prone to violent detonation if damaged.
LanguageData.AA_NightMule.description: A hardy pack beast, used for transporting loads or doing other heavy work. Nightmules originate from a RimWorld orbiting a very faint star -the native planet of an elusive race know as the Forsaken- so they have adapted to environments with low sunlight.
LanguageData.AA_NightRam.description: A stubborn herbivore that shares much of its genome with the predatory Nightling, hinting at a common origin.
LanguageData.AA_Radyak.description: Peaceful herbivores bred to thrive in high radiation environments. Their ruminant digestive tract is composed of six bionic stomachs, reinforced with a lead-lined biolattice designed to extract residual radioactive material from grass cells.
LanguageData.AA_SpinedGow.description: Farm animals with cow and goat characteristics, bred to survive in extreme environments.
